name: tickpack
tagline: Lossless tick-data codec that finds the price grid inside float columns and beats Gorilla XOR
trendOrigin: QuestDB (Trend 1). Time-series databases store prices as f64 and compress them with Gorilla-style XOR. Market prices are really decimals on a tick grid, so that layout wastes bits a codec could get back.

warnings: the spec promised a benchmark and none is present
